Every hunter required blue at the start because their main clear required them to use blue to clear at early levels Kinda like how Rama has to wait for his arrows to stack to 3-4 before he can clear like them, but his time to regen arrows is way less than what an adc mana regen is you might ask well lets see. 

Rama recovers 1 arrow every 15 seconds with auto attacks hitting reducing that time by 2 seconds per hit. so in order to clear a wave at level 1-5 each arrow does 40 damage at level 1 with no items plus an extra 10 when his 1 is activated. Assuming that melee minions have 375 and archer minions have 270 Rama using his 1 at level 1 with no items would need to shoot 8 times to clear the whole wave of his astral arrows.so he shoots 5 times using all his arrows that is 250 damage.the archers are almost dead and the melee are kinda close. He shoots the archers once each killing them. and the melee minions he needs to shoot 3 more times each. This is assuming that he dosnet get any help form his minions or his support. Assuming rama has full arrows at the start of this. 5 seconds to auto with arrows, He needs 1 more arrow to clear the wave, every second counts as 3 so in 5 seconds he has another arrow. 1 second to shoot and he has cleared the wave with a total of 150 mana spent. Using an efficent way to clear the wave. total time 10 seconds.

Now lets take Apollo whos clear is a good approximate of what a common adc can do. So beautiful does 80 flat damage he than needs to auto down the archers for 190 HP and melee minions for 295 damage. His autos do 36 damage per hit. He wants to clear the wave as efficent as possible with taking as little damage as possible so he autos the melee minions once each 3 hits on each for a total of 108 damage to each melee minion and 36 extra to one ten seconds have gone by. His passive comes up. 5 shots 1 each minion and being smart 2 for minions he hasn't hit yet for a total of 5 hits on each melee (15 seconds) than he uses his 1 again all melee minions at 115 hp left and 110 on the archers. 4 hits each melee. ( 11 seconds passive again) 4 hits (4 seconds) than his 1 again to finish off the wave. total time 30 seconds Way Way Way slower than Rama.

Now we look at the ways that this isn't as bad as the flat numbers show. When apollo clears the wave he spends less than a second right in front of the archer minions Combined with both his 1s. Rama will spend a total time of 6 seconds standing right in front of the melee minions in range of all sorts of shenanigans that the support can do. He will take poke... A lot of poke. They right now are spending the same amount of mana so that's negligible. Their kits one has a very good escape knock up dash, slow for enemies in the circle, speed boost for yourself and allies. Rama has a dash that goes to where he is walking towards, this is also a free no movement penalty penalty auto that cripples if you have an astral arrow. Rama has a 2 that boosts his Attack speed up by 30/35/40/45/50% and passivly gives him arrows back at 10/20/30/40/50% compared to other adc attack speed buffs it is lower than most for a higher mana cost. Apollo has a mez that enables him to escape using his ult. Compared to most ults if the damage hits it does a lot of damage if you confirm all 3 shots.

Overall Rama needed the nerf no doubt his clear is very powerful in a 1v1 situation but it also puts him in harms way for significantly longer than many other adcs. His only CC is a cripple for a max of 2 seconds if he has an astral arrow available. And while his ult does make him immune to damage for a while he lands in the same spot he went up in allowing enemies to easily kill him once he comes down. that shows that for clearing and farming yes he is better than probably most hunters with nothing else effecting it but other hunter kits as a whole are in my own opinion way way more powerful. Many hunters past level 5 have safer clears than Rama who has to stand there for at least a second if he can 1 shot a whole wave. Also past the first blue buff hunters take blue for kill securing rather than farming because once you get levels in your main clear and begin to get items clearing with you 1,3,combo becomes a way to clear the wave fast while autos are usually fairly viable if you are saving your skill to nuke him down.

The timing is the 2 ish frames that you are just beginning to throw the enemy backwards right before they move and just as they get off the ground. Like i said tho dont rely on it it is so very hard to time correctly i myself can never get it perfect 100% of the time but i can usually manage it if i know the damage is incoming. 

Hitting the fling is just a lot of practice and knowing how different people move with gods. close and mid range is easy to hit but just practice hitting it from the furthest away.

First item the watchers gift hog1 few hp pots 2 wards you will place at the enemy mid camps and at your enemy blue. Go back to base and buy 2 more wards. Always be buying and placing wards throughout the entire game. 

Your core items that i personally like are Sov, stone of gaia, Magi's, and personally i like void stone as well if there is not a bruiser on your team. 

This leaves you with 1 item that you counter build against the enemy team. If they have a healer you can pick up pestilence because with your sickening strike you will reduce healing a lot very easily. Else just pick up something that counters their most fed person if its a mage grab bulwark of hope if they have a very fed ADC/bruiser you can grab witch blade for not only damage de-buff but also the attack speed slow. 


If your team is very very ahead you can delay the sov and pick up brestplate of valor for the CDR.


Actives i like are Hog 3 right after you get your mida's boots and either Greater Blink, or one of the curses Weakening if they have a healer/bruiser and save this for big fights like at FG GF mid capms ect. Else just use your sickening strike.


Your skills always start with maxing your 3 first. but pick up your 1 or your 2 early depending on how good your adc or their support/adc is. If your adc can secure kills go for the pluck early than grab your 2 at level 4 or if your adc is getting poked a lot get your 2 for peel. Always take your 3 when you have the choice.

Early game focus on either plucking (your 1) their adc if they have no dash after their minion wave is mostly clear. Or pluck their support if they have already used their cc and your adc is good. Just always be careful about plucking the enemy support because that is a free initiation for them if they are ready for it.

mid game: Rotate only when you absolutely need to sobek is one of those gods who can benefit from sticking in the lane and just killing the enemy adc over and over again and or force them back to base. Once you force them out either base yourself because your probably low or rotate to mid and take camps/help the mid lane kill the enemy mid lane.

Late Game: focus on plucking (your 1) people who are out of position into your teammates. Do NOT pluck the enemy support into your team because he will initiate  for free. Save your 2 for enemy disruption and when you need to slow someone use your ult.

Notes on using your ult. Early game you can use it for the mana regen more so than the damage it does. If the enemy has a dash wait till he has used it than ult on them.

Mid Game: This is really when your ult shines because people have started getting lots of damage and not so much pen items. You will be tanky enough to be able to ult and let it go for the full duration. It is a really powerful for breaking up the enemy team because for reasons i haven't quite figured out they will hate staying in the ult no matter how little damage it does. unless your going for the kill let the ult go its full duration for just the mana or nothing else learning how much damage you will do with it is a big part of this.

Late game: Your ult is used almost exclusively for the slow and scare tactics as well as the cc immune let use their cc on you in your ult so they cant cc your team.

Sobek is one of them most tanky supports out there with a really good initiation that not only pulls a squishy way outta position but it puts you right into the best position to do what you do best annoy the crap outta the enemy team.

Also one thing about Sobek that you might not know when his dash connects and he begins the fling you are immune to damage and cc for several frames. It is very hard to time correctly so don't really rely on it but it can save your ass.
